amendment.reason: Infrastructure retry, not a scientific change. Under trial-plan-v2.json the supervisor launched stage 0 as RUN-BINSTD-367c7a, which exited 1 at 'import numpy' (ModuleNotFoundError raised from implementation/gf2n.py line 11, reached from run.py line 31) because numpy was absent on the host. The process failed before any stage-0 computation or write: stage0/ holds only .gitkeep and the run directory holds only the eight supervisor-generated files (no manifest.yaml, no raw-result.json). The supervisor never reuses a run directory (execute_trial creates it exclusively), so that run id is spent, and trial-plan-v2.json cannot proceed (stage 0 is needs_reconciliation and stages 1-2 depend on it). The additive repair is this successor plan with a fresh stage-0 run id and a fresh single-task queue and executor card. Nothing was measured by the failed attempt; it is infrastructure signal only, never evidence.
